media.caption: Heart muscle tissue stained for natriuretic peptide A (NPPA). Brown: NPPA protein. Blue: cell nuclei (hematoxylin counterstain).

media.selection: HPA tissue enriched gene for heart muscle; IHC reliability enhanced, medium expression
